Indian Railways Deploys KAVACH 4.0 on South Central Railway

Indian Railways has deployed KAVACH 4.0, an automatic train protection system, for the first time on the South Central Railway. This marks the initial implementation of the KAVACH 4.0 version of the system on this railway division.
